title: Go-to-Prod Concordance: Compact Checklist + KPI Quickscan
content:
Purpose:
Compact, cross-functional pre-production checklist plus a pared-down KPI quickscan to use during soft rollouts (alpha -> canary -> 100%). Designed to be readable in 5 minutes by eng/product/ops leads.

Scope and intended audience:
- Scope: API surface changes, model swaps, routing policy updates, and associated console/observability changes.
- Audience: Eng oncall, platform lead, product PM, SRE, solutions engineering contact, and the release comms owner.

Status snapshot (as of last_modified):
- Feature branch merged to release-candidate: yes (PR #2419).
- Dedicated smoke env build: green (build-2026.02.15).
- Canary quota reserved: 1 GPU pool, low-traffic zone.
- Security review: pending small KMS config (sec-quick-2026).

Pre-launch concordance checklist (top-level, actionable)
1) Code & infra:
   - [x] PR merged to release-candidate (platform PR 2419)
   - [x] E2E smoke test run (smoke-suite v4) — green except intermittent image-serve timing on i-2
   - [ ] DB migration backward-compatible? (owner: Diego) — follow-up: confirm migration-step gating flag
   - [x] Canary capacity reserved (dedicated pool)

2) Model & serving:
   - [x] Model artifact pinned and checksumed (model v3.2.1, sha256: abc...)
   - [x] Quantization profile applied (int8-latency profile)
   - [ ] Fallback variant verified (v3.1 fallback): load test missing final latency histogram
   - Notes: KV-cache warming script added to canary start-up; ensure warm-run prior to traffic unpause

3) Observability & alerts:
   - [x] Dashboards created: per-route latency, per-model tokens/sec, error-rate by code
   - [x] Log sampling configured (10% for DEBUG spans)
   - [ ] Alert thresholds agreed: page on p50>400ms for 5min or p99>1200ms for 3m (SRE to confirm)
   - Tracing: trace-id sticky headers validated with front-end agent

4) Cost & quotas:
   - [x] Cost estimator updated with expected tokens/sec and batch-size (ops-est-2026-02)
   - [ ] Billing alert: daily projected overspend > 20% above forecast — hook in billing slack #billing-alerts

5) Security & compliance:
   - [x] Data path inspection done — no new exfil vectors found
   - [ ] KMS policy update awaiting security review (ticket: SEC-1142)
   - PII handling: inference logs scrubbed at ingestion stage, sample validation done (see confluence)

6) Rollout ops & comms:
   - [x] Rollout plan in product-ops: alpha (10 orgs) -> canary (1%) -> ramp
   - [ ] Runbook updated for rollback (contains immediate steps, who to call, and how to flip routing)
   - Slack channel for roll: #prod-rollout-go-live (owner: @maya)

KPIs — Quickscan (what to watch during alpha/canary)
- Primary health signals (real-time):
  - p50 latency (API-generate, route=prod): target < 200ms for short prompts, alert p50>400ms
  - p99 latency: soft target < 1200ms, page if > 1500ms for 5min
  - Error rate (5xx + model-timeouts): baseline < 0.2%, alert if > 0.5%

- Business & quality signals (sampled, 1–2x daily):
  - Successful-response-rate (semantic validity check): target > 97% on eval set A
  - Latency tail cost delta: monitor token-cost-per-req vs baseline (target delta < +8%)
  - Regression score: automated eval against golden prompts; fail if delta quality < -3 points

- Capacity & economics (daily):
  - GPU utilization per pool: target 60–70% steady; alert >90% sustained 10m
  - Batch size distribution: median batch 4–8 tokens; ensure batching doesn't increase p99 > threshold

Risk ladder and immediate contingency actions
- Low (minor metric bump): increase autoscale temporarily, enable cache warming, notify SRE slack.
- Medium (sustained p99 spike or error rate > 0.5%): throttle non-critical routes, move traffic to fallback model v3.1, open incident channel.
- High (data leak or critical SLA breach): full rollback to previous routing policy, pause new requests at LB, escalate to CTO-level incident with legal & security engaged.

Owners & roll-call (who does what)
- Release owner / single point: Asha Mehta (product-ops)
- Platform lead: Diego Torres (eng-platform) — infra migrations, canary gating
- SRE oncall: Evan Wu (sre) — monitoring, alerts, paging thresholds
- Security reviewer: Nina Shah (security) — KMS + compliance sign-off
- Solutions engineering contact: Maya Patel — customer comms and support playbook

Quick timeline (milestones)
- T-72h: freeze non-critical changes, finalize runbook, ensure migrations backed out plan set
- T-24h: smoke env run complete, KPIs baseline snapshot captured, canary pool warmed
- T+0: open canary to alpha orgs, monitor 15-minute cadence metrics for 2 hours
- T+6h: decision checkpoint — proceed to canary ramp or rollback

Open items (to resolve before canary)
- [ ] Finalize alert thresholds with SRE and oncall (owner: Evan) — depends on load-test histograms by 2026-02-20
- [ ] Confirm migration backward-compat gating flag and add tests (owner: Diego)
- [ ] Security sign-off on KMS config (owner: Nina)
- [ ] Update rollback runbook with exact routing flip commands and test them in staging (owner: Asha + Diego)

Quick links and artifacts
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/2419
- Release checklist confluence (compact): https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/PROD/GTOP-compact
- JIRA epic: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/PRODOPS-879
- Runbook draft (staging): https://confluence.redwood.ai/pages/viewpage.action?pageId=98765

Notes to self / short-term wins
- Keep the KPI quickscan to 6 metrics max during alpha — less noise helps decision velocity.
- If the p50 moves but p99 stays stable, prioritize improving batching/caching rather than rolling back model.
- Run a live tabletop with oncall and platform lead 24h before T-0 to walk through rollback command sequence.

If you read nothing else: confirm KMS sign-off, alert thresholds, and rollback commands are all tested in staging. Ping me in #product-ops and drop any blockers in this doc (comments).
